response.sql: WITH site_stats AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(sm.facetresmm / sm.geomdeltamm) AS site_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS valid_mesh_count FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL AND sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_averages AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio FROM site_stats GROUP BY insurstat), filtered_sites AS (SELECT ss.zoneregistry, ss.insurstat, ss.site_avg_ratio, ss.valid_mesh_count, sa.status_avg_ratio FROM site_stats ss JOIN status_averages sa ON ss.insurstat = sa.insurstat WHERE ss.site_avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio) SELECT fs.insurstat, AVG(fs.site_avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_of_kept_sites, SUM(fs.valid_mesh_count) AS total_mesh_records, AVG(fs.site_avg_ratio - fs.status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM filtered_sites fs GROUP BY fs.insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: All geomdeltamm values are non-zero, preventing division-by-zero errors.
